title: email.send input
description: Two-phase owner-approved send of an email.draft result. account, draft_id, and draft_digest bind the exact durable draft content receipt; no unbound draft is sent. Phase one requests the kernel's exact-scope decision without an effect. Phase two supplies approvalId as a selector, never authority; the kernel consumes the decision and the adapter verifies the recorded business intent before sending the bound content once. Credentials and private MIME bindings never travel in tool arguments. Exact command retries deduplicate.
